compulsory_education.notes: A child who will reach age 6 before January 1 of the current school year is of mandatory attendance age. A 6-year-old exemption exists: parents may file an affidavit with the local school district stating the child will participate in an exempt school program, delaying formal filing until the child's 7th birthday. Compulsory attendance continues until the child turns 18 or completes secondary education, whichever comes first.
